$comentario: The Settings screen. The printed template's text does NOT go here —the document's language is not the screen's (RN-29)— but each template's NAME does, because it is chosen from here.
settings_description: The business details, the currency, the tax and how what you print looks.
settings_trade_name_hint: This is the one shown in the menu and at the top of the document.
settings_legal_name_hint: Only if it differs from the trade name.
settings_locale_hint: What anyone who has not picked another one for their session gets.
settings_document_locale_hint: The invoice is for the customer and for the tax authority, so it does not follow the screen language.
settings_logo_hint: Shown in the menu and on the document. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 250 KB.
settings_logo_missing: The business has no logo configured.
settings_logo_undecodable: The stored logo could not be decoded.
settings_no_svg: SVGs are not accepted: they are XML and can carry code inside. The logo is served from the same origin as the POS, so only images are accepted.
settings_accent_hint: The shade for the dark theme and the text color are calculated from this one.
settings_accent_chart_warning: This shade does not stand out enough against the chart background, so the bars keep the validated color. The rest of the interface does use it.
settings_currency_hint: Pick one and the rest is filled in. The separators stay editable because the local convention does not always match the standard.
settings_tax_hint: Applied when charging. Returns of earlier sales keep using the rate they were charged with, not this one.
settings_money_preview: This is how amounts will look
settings_template_hint: What gets printed when charging and from each invoice.
$comentario_plantillas: Each template's name and description. The keys are the ids stored in `document.template`: the value is not translated.
settings_template_receipt_description: One column, no colors, meant for the roll in the counter printer. It is what a corner store wants: it comes out in two seconds and uses no ink.
settings_template_classic_description: Full page, a color band with the business name, issuer and customer details facing each other, a plain table and a totals block on the right. Good for sending by email.
settings_template_modern_description: Full page with a diagonal header, the logo up front, a table with a colored head and a contact footer. The same information as the classic one, with more brand presence.
$comentario_monedas: Each currency's name. The key is the ISO 4217 code, which is what gets stored.
settings_document_color_hint: Bands and headers. It does not affect the thermal receipt.
settings_legal_notice_hint: While no electronic invoice is issued, it is worth saying so here.
settings_notes_placeholder: E.g., Exchanges are accepted within 8 days with the invoice.
settings_einvoicing_hint: The issuer's details for the tax authority. They are stored to have them ready; VentaSys does not issue documents yet.
settings_einvoicing_warning_title: It does not issue documents yet.
settings_einvoicing_warning_1: Issuing for real means signing the XML with the business's cryptographic key, sending it to the tax authority and waiting for the acceptance reply. None of that is implemented, so checking this box does not make anything be issued: it only records that the business invoices electronically.
settings_einvoicing_warning_2: The key and its PIN are neither asked for nor stored. Keeping a credential the system does not use is giving away the risk for nothing.
settings_einvoicing_enabled_hint: Once enabled, every sale is issued as an electronic receipt or, with a customer, as an electronic invoice, and the document says so. Earlier sales do not change. It is worth adjusting the legal notice in the Documents tab too.
settings_economic_activity_hint: The 6-digit code registered with the tax authority.
settings_missing_1: The tax authority requires the goods and services classification on every line. The catalog has no such field today.
settings_missing_2: A 20-digit numbering per branch and terminal, and a 50-digit key that includes the ID number and the date.
settings_missing_3: The XML is signed with the taxpayer's cryptographic key. It is the piece that forces handling a secret on the server.
settings_missing_4: It is sent to the tax authority and the acceptance is awaited, which is asynchronous: the status has to be stored and retried.
$comentario_validacion: What the save action replies. It goes here and not in validation.json because these are rules of this screen, not of the validator.
settings_bad_color: {field} has to be a color in #rrggbb format.
settings_logo_bad_type: The logo has to be PNG, JPG or WebP. SVGs are not accepted, for security.
settings_logo_too_big: The logo cannot be larger than {max} KB.
settings_missing_5: If the tax authority does not answer, the sale still has to be chargeable and sent later. A POS cannot sit waiting with the customer standing there.
settings_branch_terminal_hint: Set by your session and used in the document's sequence number. They are managed under Branches, not here.
$comentario_fe: The tax authority credentials (F6). What is absent here matters as much as what is present: there is no label to show the file, the PIN or the password, because no endpoint returns them.
settings_fe_unavailable: The e-invoicing status could not be read. The rest of the settings can still be changed.
settings_fe_active_sandbox_hint: Whatever is issued is a rehearsal and has no fiscal effect.
settings_fe_active_production_hint: Whatever is issued has fiscal effect before the tax authority.
settings_fe_not_in_use: Set up separately, not in use
settings_fe_no_certificate: There is no certificate for this environment yet.
settings_fe_certificate_expired: The certificate has expired. Nothing can be signed until you upload a new one.
settings_fe_certificate_expiring: The certificate expires in {days} day(s). Request a new one before the day arrives.
settings_fe_pin_hint: Used once, to open the file. It is not stored anywhere.
settings_fe_certificate_required: Choose the .p12 file the tax authority gave you.
settings_fe_certificate_too_big: The certificate cannot exceed {kb} KB. A real one is under 5 KB.
settings_fe_certificate_removed: Certificate removed. The transmission credentials are untouched.
settings_fe_atv_password_hint: Stored encrypted and never returned to this screen. Type it again to change it.
settings_fe_atv_missing: The user name and password are missing. The certificate only signs; transmitting needs both.
settings_fe_atv_unverified: Saved, but never checked. Test the connection before invoicing day arrives.
settings_fe_atv_saved: Credentials saved. Test the connection to confirm they work.
settings_fe_test_connection_hint: Asks the tax authority for a token and throws it away. It issues no document.
settings_fe_connection_ok: The tax authority accepted the credentials.
settings_fe_confirm_description: This change is recorded with your name and the date.
settings_fe_confirm_effect: From now on the documents you issue stop being a rehearsal and carry fiscal effect.
settings_fe_confirm_certification: The tax authority requires having issued at least one invoice, one ticket and one credit note in sandbox. We will not stop you, but if you have not, your production documents will bounce.
$comentario_sucursales: Branches and tills (T-608, RF-26). The three- and five-digit codes go inside the document key, so they are always shown and cannot be changed once created.
settings_offices_hint: Each location is a branch and each checkout point, a till. Their codes go inside every document number, so they cannot be changed once created.
settings_offices_unavailable: Branches could not be read. Please try again in a moment.
settings_offices_quota_hint: Active ones are counted. Turning one back on also takes a slot.
settings_offices_branch_full: Your plan does not allow another active branch.
settings_offices_terminal_full: Your plan does not allow another active till.
settings_offices_branch_code_hint: Three digits. If you type 1 it is saved as 001.
settings_offices_terminal_code_hint: Five digits. If you type 1 it is saved as 00001.
settings_offices_code_locked: The code cannot be changed once created: it would move the number of every document already issued.
settings_offices_branch_active_hint: Deactivating it also turns off its tills.
settings_offices_terminal_active_hint: An inactive till is not offered when opening a shift.
settings_offices_delete_warning: This cannot be undone. If it has sales or cash sessions the system will stop you: deactivate it instead.
settings_document_types_hint: Each screen offers only the ones turned on. Those that cannot be used yet say why.
settings_doctype_ticket: Sale to the end consumer, without customer details.
settings_doctype_always_on: Always on: every return of an issued document goes through a credit note.
settings_doctype_last_counter: At least one of the two is needed to sell.
settings_doctype_pending_debit: Not available yet: it will be issued from the open invoice.
settings_doctype_pending_export: Not available yet: products need their tariff heading and customers their foreign address.
settings_doctype_pending_purchase: Not available yet: suppliers cannot be marked as non-taxpayers yet.
settings_doctype_pending_receipt: Requires selling on credit, which the system does not do yet.
settings_issuer_id_hint: Registered by support: it matches the signing certificate and goes into the key of every document. If it needs correcting, contact support.
settings_issuer_id_missing: This company has no issuer tax ID registered yet. Ask support for it: without it, electronic documents cannot be issued.
settings_address_hint: Free text. It is printed on documents that are not electronic invoices.
settings_location_hint: Only required if you issue electronic documents. Use the same one registered with Hacienda.
settings_location_required: Required because electronic invoicing is active. It must match the one registered with Hacienda.
settings_other_signs_hint: Describe how to get there: street, number or nearby landmarks. At least five characters.
